title: Tower of Hanoi
description: Write a Zig program that prints the solution steps for the Tower of Hanoi puzzle with 3 disks.
hints: Tower of Hanoi uses recursion: move n-1 disks, then the largest disk, then n-1 disks again
The base case is when n = 0 (no disks to move)

steps.title: Set up the Tower of Hanoi project
steps.description: Initialize the project structure and create the main entry point. Set up any necessary configuration files and import required libraries.
hints: Create the main source file for Tower of Hanoi
Set up the basic program structure

verification.failureMessage: Initialize the project with proper structure.

steps.title: Implement the core logic for Tower of Hanoi
steps.description: Write the main algorithm or core functionality that drives this project. Break down the problem into smaller functions for clarity.
hints: Start with the simplest part of the algorithm
Test each function as you write it
Use descriptive variable and function names

steps.title: Handle edge cases and errors
steps.description: Add checks for edge cases such as empty inputs, invalid data, boundary conditions, and error states. Provide clear feedback for invalid inputs.
hints: Test with empty strings or zero values

steps.title: Format and display the output
steps.description: Format the output in a clear, readable way. If applicable, display results in a structured format with labels and proper formatting.
hints: Add labels to output values for clarity
